Allow activity recognition?

Aevum uses activity recognition to detect automatically whether you are driving, walking or cycling — so that drives, walks and bike rides are recorded without you having to start them. The detection runs continuously, including while the app is closed.
Car trips are detected and recorded with their route
Walks and bike rides are recorded as activities
Automatic sleep detection from your movement
Your movement data is processed exclusively on your device and is never transmitted. You can revoke the permission at any time in the Android system settings.
Allow notifications?

Aevum uses notifications to show you when an activity is running and to inform you when one starts or stops automatically in the background. Without this permission those automatic switches happen silently.
See which activity is running right now
Get told when Aevum starts or stops an activity for you
Reminders for running timers
Notifications are created locally on your device. There is no push service and no notification server. You can revoke the permission at any time in the Android system settings.
Allow usage access?

Aevum uses usage access to read how long and how often you use your apps. This is what powers Digital Balance — screen time statistics and app limits. The permission is granted in a special Android settings page, not in the usual permission dialog.
Digital Balance: see your screen time per app
Set daily limits and block apps temporarily
Automatic sleep detection based on your screen activity
Usage data is evaluated exclusively on your device and is never transmitted. You can revoke usage access at any time in the Android system settings (Special access → Usage access).
Allow calendar access?

Aevum reads your calendar to start the matching activity for your appointments automatically — for example a meeting or a workout. Without this permission you can still use calendar rules, but you have to pick the events yourself.
Appointments start and stop the matching activity
Choose which calendars are used
Rules can be limited to certain events

Your calendar is read only — Aevum never creates or changes appointments. The entries are evaluated exclusively on your device and are never transmitted. You can revoke the permission at any time in the Android system settings.
